newspaper.headline: Knowing Your Limits Makes a Great Technician
newspaper.lead: IT service experts remind us that a good technician knows when to hand a case to a specialist team, especially when there are signs of an attack or important data is at stake.

impact.good: Yesterday, Nusa Digital laptops were refreshed: disks cleared, updates installed, and troublesome drivers rolled back.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, most software problems were solved, though some laptops are still slow. Pak Joko asked for a recheck.
impact.bad: Yesterday, many laptops went back to their owners still slow or faulty. Complaints to the IT Workshop are rising.

tip.title: Tip: Suspicious? Disconnect, Don't Delete
tip.text: If a laptop acts strangely, unplug it from the network and hand it to the security team. Don't delete anything: the traces are evidence.

newspaper.classified: WANTED: The owner of an unnamed laptop found in the floor 3 meeting room. Ask at the IT Workshop. — Security
